## Abandonment follow-up messages

Use these only for people who have consented to WhatsApp/SMS/email marketing. Do **not** use stock-pressure language or invent a discount. Before activating, confirm that the prepaid saving, 30-day money-back guarantee, replacement policy and installation support are currently live and accurately worded on the site.

### Recommended flow
- **Browse abandoners** (viewed product, no cart): 1 message after 2–4 hours; 1 final message after 24 hours.
- **Cart / checkout abandoners**: 1 message after 20–40 minutes; 1 reassurance message after 20–24 hours; stop after that unless they re-engage.
- Use a unique recovery link: `{{checkout_link}}` for cart/checkout users and `{{product_link}}` for browsers.

---

## 1) Viewed product, didn’t add to cart
**Send 2–4 hours later**

> Hi {{first_name}}, childproofing a home can feel like one more overwhelming thing on the new-parent list.
>
> The Peach Bucket brings together protection for the everyday spots little explorers reach first—corners, sockets, cabinets/fridge and doors—in one kit.
>
> See what’s included and decide at your pace: {{product_link}}

**Follow-up after 24 hours**

> A quick note from The Peach Bucket: you don’t need to childproof the entire house in one day.
>
> Our 6-in-1 kit is designed to help you start with the key danger areas, with installation video support if you need guidance.
>
> Explore the kit here: {{product_link}}

---

## 2) Added to cart, didn’t check out
**Send 20–40 minutes later**

> Hi {{first_name}}, your Peach Bucket kit is still waiting for you.
>
> It includes childproofing essentials for 6 common home danger areas, so you can avoid hunting for separate products when you are already busy with your little one.
>
> Complete your order here: {{checkout_link}}

**Reassurance follow-up after 20–24 hours**

> Still deciding? Totally understandable.
>
> With The Peach Bucket, you get guided 1-to-1 installation video support after purchase, so you are not left figuring it out alone.
>
> Resume your checkout whenever you’re ready: {{checkout_link}}

---

## 3) Reached checkout, didn’t pay
**Send 20–40 minutes later**

> Hi {{first_name}}, it looks like checkout wasn’t completed for your Peach Bucket kit.
>
> If you had a question about what is included, installation, delivery or the policy, just reply to this message—we’ll help you make a clear decision.
>
> Your checkout link: {{checkout_link}}

**Follow-up after 20–24 hours**

> Parenting purchases should feel considered, not rushed.
>
> The Peach Bucket kit is backed by the policies shown on our website, including a 30-day money-back guarantee and eligible-failure replacement coverage. Please review the full terms before ordering.
>
> Complete your order here: {{checkout_link}}

---

## 4) Optional prepaid nudge — only if the customer can still use it
**Use instead of, not in addition to, the 24-hour cart/checkout follow-up.**

> Hi {{first_name}}, a small heads-up: prepaid orders currently save ₹299 on The Peach Bucket kit.
>
> If the kit feels right for your home, you can complete your order here: {{checkout_link}}
>
> Questions before you decide? Reply here and we’ll help.

---

## Reply macros for your support person

**“What does the kit include?”**
> It includes childproofing items for corners/edges, sockets, cabinets/fridge and doors. You can see the full contents on the product page here: {{product_link}}

**“Will I know how to install it?”**
> Yes—after purchase, we provide 1-to-1 installation video support. Our team can guide you through the setup process.

**“Can I return it?”**
> The product page currently lists a 30-day money-back guarantee. Please review the policy terms on the website before placing your order: {{policy_link}}

## Implementation checks
1. Create separate automations for **product view**, **add to cart**, and **checkout started**; suppress a person immediately after purchase.
2. Add UTM tags by message and step, e.g. `utm_source=whatsapp&utm_campaign=cart_recovery&utm_content=20min`.
3. Use the exact product/checkout link matching the product page the person visited; your store has two recorded product URLs, so avoid sending the wrong one.
4. Test each link, coupon/prepaid condition, and the stated policies before going live.
5. Track delivered, clicked, replied, recovered orders and opt-outs separately. Do not judge success only from Meta-attributed purchases.

segments: Product viewers with no add to cart
exclusions: Recent support conversations where the message would be redundant

offer_rationale: The copy leads with reducing the burden of piecing together multiple childproofing products, rather than making unverified safety or injury-prevention promises.
Installation support is used as a decision-risk reducer for cart and checkout abandoners.
The ₹299 prepaid saving is an optional conditional nudge, not a fabricated or blanket discount.
No genuine-scarcity wording is used because stock status is unknown.

implementation.sms_note: Shorten each message substantially for SMS; retain one benefit, one CTA and the recovery link.

claim_approval_gate: Verify the current ₹299 prepaid saving before using the optional nudge.
Verify the exact wording, eligibility and exclusions for the 30-day money-back and 720-day eligible-failure replacement policies.
Do not state that the kit prevents accidents, is certified, or is suitable for a particular child age unless substantiated and approved.

questions: Which channels do you actually have available now—WhatsApp, email, SMS, or all three?
Is the ₹299 prepaid saving available on every order, and does it apply automatically or with a code?
What are the most common questions or objections received in DMs/calls before purchase?
assumptions: The owner wants customer-facing recovery copy, not technical automation setup.
The supplied website claims are marketing assertions that need operational verification before being used in automated messages.
No cash-on-delivery, delivery-time, shipping-fee, certification, or stock claims should be included because they were not confirmed.
Links and consent status can be passed into the relevant automation.
